outline:
E-Marketing involves information technology and marketing. The course will explore information technology/systems concepts from a non-technical perspective and examine how the marketing function is influenced by emerging technology trends. In addition, some famous e-marketing technique would be introduced in this course including recommended system, customer segmentation and so on.   This course also discusses the journal paper to enhance the students' theoretical bases

NOTE: This is an advanced course. The student should take course  "Big Data Analytics"
before. This course actually will not use a heavy amount of programming.  You can use any analysis tool  including weka or rap miner....
schedule:
Part I: e marketing concepts
1. E marketing in context
2. E marketing environment
3. E marketing strategy
4. D E marketing management

Part II: Data analysis of E marketing concepts
1. Recommended system
2. Opinion mining
3. Social network analysis
4 .Customer segmentation

Part III: paper presentation
Part IV: project presentation
assessment:
Attendance: 10%
Participation and discussion every week: 40%
Paper presentation ~30%
Term project: 20%
